# Traefik Proxy v3.7

> Traefik Documentation

Generated from [traefik/traefik](https://github.com/traefik/traefik) branch `v3.7` at commit [`faa1eb590646`](https://github.com/traefik/traefik/tree/faa1eb590646aed94e561e24a59be0c47353ae95/docs). MkDocs-specific syntax (tabbed code fences, admonitions, includes) has been converted to plain Markdown.

## Overview

- [What is Traefik](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlshdev/traefik-llms-docs/main/traefik/v3.7/pages/index.md): Traefik Proxy, an open-source Edge Router, auto-discovers configurations and supports major orchestrators, like Kubernetes. Read the technical documentation.
- [Features](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlshdev/traefik-llms-docs/main/traefik/v3.7/pages/features/index.md): Compare features across Traefik Proxy, Traefik Hub API Gateway (including AI Gateway capabilities), and Traefik Hub API Management to choose the right solution for your needs.
- [Extend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlshdev/traefik-llms-docs/main/traefik/v3.7/pages/extend/extend-traefik.md): Extend Traefik with custom plugins using Yaegi and WebAssembly.
- [Govern](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlshdev/traefik-llms-docs/main/traefik/v3.7/pages/govern/index.md): Learn how Traefik Hub provides comprehensive API Gateway and API Management capabilities to govern, secure, and manage your APIs at scale.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlshdev/traefik-llms-docs/main/traefik/v3.7/pages/getting-started/faq.md): Check out our FAQ page for answers to commonly asked questions on getting started with Traefik Proxy. Read the technical documentation.

## Secure

## Observe

- [Observe / Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlshdev/traefik-llms-docs/main/traefik/v3.7/pages/observe/overview.md): Traefik Proxy provides comprehensive monitoring and observability capabilities to maintain reliability and efficiency.
- [Observe / Logs & Access Logs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlshdev/traefik-llms-docs/main/traefik/v3.7/pages/observe/logs-and-access-logs.md): Logs and Access Logs in Traefik Proxy provide real-time insight into the health of your system. They enable swift error detection and intervention through alerts. By centralizing logs, you can streamline the debugging process during incident resolution.
- [Observe / Metrics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlshdev/traefik-llms-docs/main/traefik/v3.7/pages/observe/metrics.md): Metrics in Traefik Proxy offer a comprehensive view of your infrastructure's health. They allow you to monitor critical indicators like incoming traffic volume. Metrics graphs and visualizations are helpful during incident triage in understanding the causes and implementing proactive measures.
- [Observe / Tracing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlshdev/traefik-llms-docs/main/traefik/v3.7/pages/observe/tracing.md): Tracing in Traefik Proxy allows you to track the flow of operations within your system. Using traces and spans, you can identify performance bottlenecks and pinpoint applications causing slowdowns to optimize response times effectively.
